name: com.github.icloudthink.locate.amap.AmapLocateService
description: iCloudThink’s AMap location service requests a high-accuracy location fix and sends the province, city, and district to the app. If Wi-Fi was off, it temporarily enables it while locating and restores its previous state when done.
disableEffect: Apps using this service lose its location result and any location-based features that depend on it.
